nodes.name: Catch workflow error
nodes.notes: Receives failed production execution metadata from the main workflow. Set this workflow as the main workflow Error Workflow. Manual Execute Workflow does not trigger it.

nodes.name: Read failed execution
nodes.notes: Read saved failed execution to recover the actual previous-node output supplied to the failed node. Credential: PostCall n8n API. Replace <YOUR_N8N_CLOUD_URL> without trailing slash. Requires n8n API access; unavailable on Cloud free trial. Failure continues with input explicitly unavailable.

nodes.name: Prepare safe error
nodes.notes: Extract workflow name, failed node, scrubbed error and actual input when saved source data exists. Remove credential/header fields and recognizable tokens. Input: execution API response plus trigger; output: exact postcall_errors columns. Never substitute the trigger as failed input. No manual values.

nodes.name: Log error in Supabase
nodes.notes: Store scrubbed error and JSON failed_input. Input: exact error columns; output: inserted error row or error item. Logging failures continue to admin alert. Credential: PostCall Supabase (Supabase API). Public schema, named table only.

nodes.name: Mark intelligence failed
nodes.notes: Mark this call reservation failed when its archived transcript ID can be recovered. Completed rows stay complete. Unknown ID performs a no-op. Failure continues to admin alert. Credential: PostCall Supabase. Replace <YOUR_SUPABASE_URL> with project URL, no trailing slash.

nodes.name: Alert Slack admin

parameters.text:
={{ 'Post-call automation failed.
Workflow: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.workflow_name+'
Node: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.failed_node+'
Error: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.error_message+'
Execution: '+($('Prepare safe error').first().json.execution_id||'unavailable')+'
Failed input recovered: '+$('Prepare safe error').first().json.failed_input.available+'
Supabase error saved: '+Boolean($('Log error in Supabase').first().json.id) }}

nodes.notes: Post short admin alert without transcript or failed-input contents. Replace <POSTCALL_ADMIN_CHANNEL_ID>. Input: error logging result and safe metadata; output: Slack response. A failure here must be inspected in Executions. Credential: PostCall Slack; invite the bot to the target internal channel.

parameters.content:
## Error recovery requirements
Select this workflow in the main workflow Settings → Error workflow. Production failures only. Keep error execution data saved. PostCall n8n API reads execution input; Cloud free trial has no public API, so input is honestly marked unavailable. Logging continues if that API or the database fails. Invite Slack bot to the admin channel.
